newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK & Co to raise HK$498m in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: SHK & Co to raise HK$498m in rights issue.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai & Company said on Thursday it would launch a rights issue to raise nearly HK$500 million.
It will comprise a two-for-five rights issue, with a subscription price of HK$1.80 per rights share.
The rights offer price represents a 25 percent discount to Wednesday's closing price of HK$2.40.
A total of 276.77 million rights shares will be offered to shareholders to raise a total of HK$498 million.
Allied Properties (H.K.) Ltd holds 229.52 million shares, representing approximately 33.18 percent of the issued share capital, of Sun Hung Kai & Co.

Of the total net proceeds of the issue of about HK$488 million, approximately HK$350 million will be used to reduce debt and the remainder to provide additional working capital to expand the company's existing businesses.
Trading in the company's shares was suspended on Wednesday and should resume on Thursday.

The Allied group acquired a controlling stake in Sun Hung Kai & Company in June, when it bought the 33.18 percent stake in the brokerage firm from the controlling shareholders, the family of chairman Tony Fung.
